correctness.rationale: Uniform all-parameter proof uses a verified classification of pairwise Hamming-graph neighborhood intersections: any nontrivial positive response after a positive root leaves either at most two candidate centers or a subset of one coordinate line. In either case its Littlestone dimension is at most one, giving local dimension at most two and global dimension at most three. Exceptional H(1,q), H(2,2), H(3,2) upper bounds are separately justified; explicit complete trees for H(2,3), H(4,2) and H(3,2), then induced-coordinate embeddings, prove sharp lower bounds. A separate exact game solver and tree verifier completed every declared finite test with ALL_CHECKS_OK. Finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Determines exactly a natural learning invariant for every finite Hamming graph and reveals the smallest q-ary two-factor graph H(2,3) with VC dimension two but adaptive Littlestone dimension three. The dimension-independent optimal mistake bound controls a concept family whose size grows exponentially with graph dimension. This specific sharp classification and exceptional online/static separation give reusable structural information beyond the published VC results.
